positions.label: I Mother Earth: ground zero, the body or land now

V Gate: what is falling away (may return)
VI Temple of Ancestors: ancestral influence, inherited gifts
VII Inner Temple: deeper magical or inner aspects, inner contacts
VIII Blood Ancestor: deepest ancestral connection in the Underworld
IX Foundation: the deep anchor from the past
X Weaver of Creation: the current fate pattern
XII Magical Temple: magical life, temples in whose orbit
XIII Home and Hearth: home, family, day-to-day world
XIV Unraveller: what is unravelling and passing away
XV River of Dreams: sleep, dreams, visions
XVI Path of Hercules: short-term future, the way ahead
